eval_dimensions.name: Task Tracking
eval_dimensions.description: Creates and updates tasks per orchestration contract

eval_dimensions.name: Announce
eval_dimensions.description: Opens with announce line identifying the skill

eval_dimensions.name: Removal Gate Enforcement
eval_dimensions.description: AskUserQuestion is called with the remove and ask sets before any git worktree remove runs

eval_dimensions.name: Keep Safety
eval_dimensions.description: Dirty, unpushed, herdr-open and unreadable worktrees are never removed

eval_dimensions.name: Survey Scope

evals.name: Merged, closed-PR and dirty worktrees together
evals.description: Survey returns remove, ask and keep entries; one gate fires, then only approved paths are removed

assertions.signal: A 'Prune merged worktrees' task is created at startup
AskUserQuestion is called listing the remove and ask sets before any git worktree remove
Options are 'Remove safe', 'Remove safe + ask' and 'Remove nothing', with exactly one marked (Recommended) and listed first
No git worktree remove runs before the AskUserQuestion answer
No inline 'Remove these worktrees?' text substitutes for the AskUserQuestion widget
worktree_prune_candidates is called with paths=[<path>] immediately before each git worktree remove

evals.name: Dirty merged checkout and herdr-open checkout
evals.description: A merged branch with uncommitted edits and a clean merged checkout open in a herdr workspace are both classified keep
evals.input: /dev10x:git-worktree-prune with a dirty merged worktree and an open herdr workspace

assertions.signal: No git worktree remove (with or without --force) targets the dirty worktree
No git worktree remove targets the worktree with an open_workspace_id

evals.name: Mirrors-only checkout needs --force
evals.description: A merged clean checkout holding only untracked .agents/ and .codex/ is removed with --force because the fresh read says force_required

assertions.signal: git worktree remove --force is used only for paths whose fresh read reports force_required: true

evals.name: Worktree became dirty between survey and removal
evals.description: The fresh read reclassifies an approved path as keep; it is skipped with the fresh reason
evals.input: /dev10x:git-worktree-prune where an approved worktree gains uncommitted edits before removal

assertions.signal: The path is skipped and reported with its fresh keep reason; no git worktree remove runs for it

evals.name: Worktree created by a parallel session mid-run
evals.description: A worktree that was not in the survey is never removed, even when it would classify as remove
evals.input: /dev10x:git-worktree-prune while a parallel session adds worktrees

assertions.signal: git worktree remove targets only paths present in the Step 1 survey
No git branch -d or -D runs; the report points to dev10x:git-branch-prune

should_trigger: Prune old worktrees in this repo
git worktree list is huge, remove the finished ones
should_not_trigger: Create a new worktree for this ticket (use dev10x:git-worktree)
